args.body:
Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback.

What works well:
- It's clear and honest about what the site is — a personal website — right from the first line, so visitors immediately know what they're looking at.
- Including your email address makes it easy for people to reach you directly.

Suggestions to make it stronger:
- The site is very sparse right now. Even a short intro about who you are, what you do, and what you're interested in would give visitors a much better sense of your work.
- Consider adding a few sections such as a brief bio, recent projects, photos, or links to your other profiles (e.g. LinkedIn, GitHub, or a portfolio).
- A bit of visual design — some headings, spacing, or a simple layout — would make the content easier to scan and more memorable.
- Adding a few recent blog posts or updates would also help people know you keep the site active.

Overall, it's a nice, clean starting point — a little more content and personality would really bring it to life. Great luck with it!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback.

What works well:
- The site immediately tells readers what you're passionate about — hiking — which gives a friendly, personal tone and a clear theme to build on.
- It's simple and approachable, which makes it easy to get started.

Suggestions to make it stronger:
- The blog is currently just a single line, so there's not much for readers to dig into. Publishing a few actual posts — trail guides, gear reviews, trip recaps, or photo essays — would make it feel like a real blog.
- Since hiking is your favorite hobby, sharing your favorite trails, recent trips, or a "best of" roundup would be a great way to showcase your personality and expertise.
- Adding a short bio/about section and some photos would help readers connect with you and make the site more visually engaging.
- Organizing posts by topic or date, and adding a small archive or tag list, would make it easier for returning readers to find what they liked.
- A newsletter signup or social links could help you build a community around the blog.

Overall, you have a great theme and a warm voice — with a few more posts and some structure, this could become a really enjoyable blog to follow. Keep it up!
